# 2.38 Installable, offline tracker: lane notes

## Plan of the whole step (three parts)

- **Part 1, the device holds the game (builder 1).** (a) "Your games" lists every game this device holds plays for that the server lacks, however old, with Dismiss that asks first: `queue-storage.ts` (`leagueId`, `listAll`, `forget`), `held-games.ts`, `held-games-panel.tsx`, `my-games-page.tsx`, `tracker.held.*` messages; tests in `held-games.test.ts` and the queue storage contract. (b) The controller starts from the state, rosters and scoring session kept on the device when the server does not answer, and settles when it does (M5; T-248, T-253): `opened-game-storage.ts` (+ memory and IndexedDB) keeps the session id, cleared with the game; `open-tracker-game.ts`, `tracker-controller.ts`; tests beside each. (c) L9: the tracker's download slimmed, measured before and after.
- **Part 2, installable and opens with no signal (builder 2).** The web app manifest and icons (`apps/web/public`, the tracker's page head), a service worker that stores only the tracker's pages and code (T-115) and replaces them only when no game is open on the device (T-127, T-158); its pure rules (what is stored, when to update) in a module with unit tests; `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` rows if a route is added.
- **Part 3, proven in a browser (builder 3).** `tests/browser/tracker-offline-test.mjs`: load the tracker, go offline before the reload, reload, keep scoring; taps accepted when the network returns if nobody took the game, listed not saved if somebody did; signing out clears the kept games; a new release waits until the open game is closed; pictures at phone and tablet width; the scoring-screen checklist lines of `docs/build/audits/live-scoring.md` answered; the area lead's review.

## Part 2

- Done, b1a26ae8 (L9): browser code looks up words with `translatorFrom` (packages/site `translate.ts`, no message file); `createTranslator` stays the server's; `@srleagues/site` marked `sideEffects: false`. No page's words changed. T-320. Every script the tracker page loads (rootMainFiles + entryJSFiles of its client manifest): 1198.9 KB raw / 328.4 KB gzip in 11 files before, 980.5 / 278.7 in 10 after part 2.
- Same build, builder 1's five page chunks: 653.8 / 167.7 before, 435.5 / 118.0 after. The catalog chunk (220.5 KB) is gone. The rest is shared by every page (React, engine, tracker code): no wide change was needed.
- Done, 5910d45f: manifest at `leagueUrl(l, 'tracker-manifest')` (`?game=` gives `start_url`), same for every league, neutral name from messages, court colour, made-up icons in `apps/web/public`; link and theme-color in the tracker page's head. Worker at `leagueUrl(l, 'tracker-worker')`, scope `/{league}/score/`, registered by `tracker-opening.tsx` (not on the dev server).
- Worker (T-319): keeps only game pages opened by the browser and `/_next/static`, `display.css`, `standalone.css`; only 200, own-origin, not redirected. Game open (IndexedDB `games` store not empty, or cannot tell): kept page first, not replaced, new worker waits; none open: network first, earlier copies dropped. Sign-out (`sign-out-form.tsx`) deletes the caches and unregisters.
- Rules are plain functions in `tracker-worker-rules.ts` (13 unit tests with the script test); `tracker-worker-script.ts` writes their own text into the worker, so tests run what the browser runs. Held game with unknown league now reads "…it may belong to another league on this device" (lead's judgement, done).
- Checks: typecheck, `npm run check`, prettier, vitest (tracker, server, site, core leagues) green, pending decisions 11, `npm run test:web` 270; browser scoring-screen 1002, scoring-plays 709, scoring-trouble 60, tracker-route 79, score-this-game 105, web-exit 332, sign-in-says 81.
- Looked at once by hand (scratch script, not committed): page controlled, one cache with the page + 16 files, an offline reload drew the tracker (format question, "Bears at Hawks"). Not verified: scoring on after it, installing on a real phone, a release while a game is open, the account email in the kept page (the scorer's own).
- Known edge: a second account signing in without signing out while the first's game is open gets the kept page of the first until the game is let go. Sign-out "keep games while plays wait" still deletes kept pages.
- Where builder 3 starts: part 3 as planned, `tests/browser/tracker-offline-test.mjs` (add to the chain); `context.setOffline(true)` then `page.reload()` works; read the cache with `caches.keys()`; for "a release waits" register the worker with another `?code=` or inspect `registration.waiting`.

## Part 3

- Done, 92e808bd + c56e9f6a (T-321, safety): each tracker page names its account (meta `srleagues-account`, refusals too); the worker deletes and never shows a kept page of another account or of nobody once the network says so (3 s wait, late answer reopens the page); each queued play keeps `accountId`: sent, listed and dismissed only for its maker. New unit tests in tracker-worker-rules, tracker-worker-script, queue-storage (new file), the queue storage contract and held-games; 651 tracker tests green.
- Done, e3ff04a4: `tests/browser/tracker-offline-test.mjs` (in the chain by its name); the page asks the worker to keep the first visit's page and files (without it an offline reload right after a first visit finds nothing).
- Browser runs (--no-build after one build): first visit kept under its account, offline reload reopens on the scoring screen, takeover lists the offline taps not saved, T-321 kept page deleted for another account, a release waits while a game is open and takes over after: all passed in the last full build run.
- FAULT found (part 1 code, not fixed): after an offline reload, if the server answers the reopening with a NEW session before the queue sends (lease lapsed, or a long retry wait), `hold` in `tracker-controller.ts` sets the offline taps aside as not saved though nobody took the game. Seen in 2 of 7 runs: score stays 2-0, taps listed "not saved". Breaks the done test's "accepted if nobody took the game".
- NOT passing: "Your games" steps and sign-out in the browser test (leaving by the screen's link with plays unsendable never navigated; now goes by the link's own address, run once with the fault above interfering); the sign-out check found the opened-game kept because plays still waited.
- Checklist (live-scoring.md §3): A2 yes (banner "No connection · 2 to send", offline-reopened picture); K6 partly (reload with no signal reopens and keeps every tap, but see the fault); M5 yes. Pictures: `.local/shots/offline/` held-games, offline-reopened, not-saved at 390x844 and 820x1180.
- Checks: typecheck, `npm run check`, prettier, vitest tracker 47 files 651, `npm run test:web` 270. NOT run: the whole chain (commands ran out), other browser tests.
- Where the next one starts: fix the fault in `hold` (a kept session's taps under the same device and account should be sent when the server says nobody else held the game, e.g. try `renew` of the kept session before `open`), then run the offline test until all steps pass, then the whole chain.
